statement: One immutable Artifact with request and call exports, one request Binding, one call Binding, and one durable outbound-call policy serve an authenticated HTTP request end to end - handle-request invokes the authorized inner Call Binding, run executes on at least two partition hosts with raw rows staying local and at least two shard runs overlapping when hosted on separate nodes, reduce produces one result returned as the HTTP response - with an undeclared target refused before dispatch, replay not executing the inner call twice, a direct CALL BINDING assertion kept, the flagship example upgraded to the composed shape, and the README showing the complete service (manifest, handlers together, both Bindings, access policy, invocation, runtime diagram) with the HTTP-cannot-initiate-distributed-calls qualification removed.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
